data.name: Tied To The Stake
data.detailed_description:
They have tied you to the stake. You cannot fly. But bear-like, you must fight the course.

An execution devised for those too mighty to kill: the stake, and all the armies of the damned, are vying to take your soul by attrition.

Death is certain, and ever near - but while you see life, the gashes do better upon them.

Gameplay Features:

Stack - Seize every arm raised against you in a never-ending arsenal of spells, melee and ranged weapons.

Shatter - Weapons unleash hidden power when they break—and they break fast. Not because they’re weak, but because you're too strong.

Stash - Save a weapon for the right moment, or weave it into your combos with perfect timing.

Swing - Wield the very chain that binds you and whirl around the stake at blistering speed.

Survive - Do the impossible. Break the unbreakable. Freedom is a distant dream - or is it?

data.short_description: Bound to the stake, beset by the damned; seize weapons, shatter them in fury, and fight for your life in this brutal first-person hack-and-slash arena. Armed with an ever-shifting arsenal and the very chain that binds you, carve through endless hordes in a desperate struggle for survival.
